review_candidates.description: Join Apaleo and shape the future of hospitality tech Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform, powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Our modular, AI-powered infrastructure lets hoteliers customise their tech stack, automate routine work and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay. If you're driven by the idea of making hospitality smarter, more human and powered by cutting-edge technology, we'd love to hear from you. About the role You'll join our Platform team as an individual contributor, working directly with our Platform Lead, who sets Platform's technical direction. Platform owns infrastructure, developer experience and security foundations for the whole engineering organisation. It's a small team, so you'll cover a wide surface area, with no dedicated DevOps or QA function to hand work to. This is a high-ownership seat. You'll take on substantial, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives, agree the direction with the Platform Lead, then drive them from first analysis through to completion with real autonomy over how you get there. We don't run a groomed backlog or sprint planning. We assign a significant topic to someone who owns it end to end. If you thrive with structure handed to you, this isn't the role. If you love spotting the problem worth solving and driving it yourself, you'll fit right in. What you'll be up to Designing and building scalable, reliable and maintainable backend systems. Spotting and scoping problems and initiatives yourself, not just picking up assigned tickets: weighing impact, priority and timing. Contributing to architectural decisions and design discussions, and bringing other teams along. Driving substantial, cross-cutting initiatives end to end, coordinating with stakeholders across engineering. Building and maintaining internal tools and infrastructure (AWS, Terraform) that help teams deliver faster and more reliably. Owning observability, logging and operational excellence to keep the platform highly available. Sharing knowledge through code reviews, design reviews and pairing, and helping raise technical standards. Spotting where AI and automation can improve how we build and run software. Some of the challenges waiting for you You'll take ownership of one of these as your first initiative, with no other distractions. Solving horizontal write-scaling for our database. Modernising our CI/CD pipeline for faster, more reliable delivery. Migrating our infrastructure-as-code fully from CloudFormation to Terraform. Extracting and reworking common services to get us ready for our next scale level. What you'll bring to the team 5+ years of backend development experience, with a track record of owning significant technical work from ambiguity through to completion. Substantial hands-on ownership of infrastructure, reliability or performance, ideally on a platform or infrastructure team rather than a pure product team. Strong engineering fundamentals that transfer across languages and cloud platforms. We care more about how you think than which stack you've used. Experience designing and scaling distributed systems in cloud-native environments (AWS preferred; strong Azure fundamentals and genuine enthusiasm for the switch work just as well). Comfort with containerised services and infrastructure-as-code (Docker, Terraform; CloudFormation exposure is relevant given our current stack). Confidence writing your own unit and integration tests, as we don't have a dedicated QA function. A project you can talk about in depth: the problem, what you did and the impact it had. Fluent English. Nice to have Direct experience with C# (.NET), PostgreSQL, AWS and ECS or Kubernetes: a great fit, though not a hard requirement if your fundamentals are strong. Experience setting up infrastructure-as-code from scratch and working with it day to day, ideally with Terraform, including migrating or consolidating from other approaches (like CloudFormation). Experience with Kafka or other event-driven and streaming systems (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ or SQS are good transferable equivalents). Experience owning observability and logging for highly available systems. Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, ChatGPT, Amazon CodeWhisperer) and a genuine interest in AI-driven engineering improvement. Experience mentoring other engineers, and introducing new technology, like AI tooling, to other teams. Culture & Growth What We Offer An International Team: Work alongside colleagues from over 20 nationalities. Growth and Development: 360° feedback reviews, an evolving career framework and an annual learning budget of €1,000+. Autonomy and Ownership: Great ideas can come from anywhere. We trust you to make decisions and contribute directly. Real Impact: Join a fast-growing scale-up transforming hospitality. From day one, your work drives real impact. Fair Pay: Competitive salaries guided by benchmarking data, with recognition for performance and contribution. Flexible Work: Work from home, the office or a hybrid mix. We focus on results, not clocking hours. Time Off and Wellbeing: 30 days of vacation and an EGYM Wellpass membership. Free Public Transport: A fully covered Deutschland Ticket for travel across Germany. Team Connection: Regular team dinners, company meetups and offsite events. How you make an impact joining Apaleo: Joining Apaleo is more than taking on a role. It's about driving real change in the hospitality industry. Your contributions will directly shape our innovative platform, influence company-wide decisions and help redefine the future of hospitality tech. At Apaleo, your voice matters, your ideas are valued and your impact is tangible. Be part of a team where your work fuels progress, collaboration sparks innovation and growth is a shared journey. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive and welcoming workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data will be handled with the utmost care and in compliance with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations. We celebrate differences and believe that diversity enriches our team and drives innovation.

review_candidates.title: Backend Engineer II - Databases
review_candidates.description: About the Company Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, a fully managed observability platform used by more than 10,000 organizations to improve reliability, resolve incidents faster, and manage telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards, Grafana Cloud connects data across different systems and supports observability for modern applications and AI-driven workflows. Grafana Labs operates as a 100% remote company, with team members across more than 40 countries. About the Role Grafana Labs is looking for a Senior Engineer to work on Tempo, the open-source distributed tracing backend that powers Grafana Cloud Traces and Grafana Enterprise Traces. Tempo helps teams search traces, generate metrics from spans, and connect tracing data with logs, metrics, and profiles across the Grafana ecosystem. The focus is shifting toward improving product reliability, operational efficiency, query performance, and the APIs that support Grafana's next generation of observability products. You'll take ownership of complex technical projects, help shape Tempo's architecture, and work with engineers and product teams to make the platform more reliable and easier to use at scale. This is a remote position open to candidates in the United States and Canada. Key Responsibilities Own significant technical projects from initial problem definition through implementation and rollout, including trace aggregation APIs, autoscaling, customer limits, and query engine improvements. Contribute to the ingestion, storage, query, and metrics-generation components of Tempo, making informed decisions about performance, cost, and complexity. Write and present design documents, participate in design reviews, and collaborate with Staff engineers and technical leads on broader engineering direction. Develop structured, deterministic, and discoverable APIs that support Grafana products, AI-driven assistants, and external integrations. Improve production reliability by working toward service-level objectives (SLOs), reducing operational overhead, automating deployments, and developing actionable alerts. Work on autoscaling, parameterized rollouts, and multi-cell operations as Tempo expands to support larger workloads. Improve query latency, ingestion performance, and the ability to handle longer query ranges, including 30-day queries. Collaborate with Product Managers and teams working on App Observability, Asserts, Drilldown, and Grafana Assistant to understand their needs and deliver the capabilities they require. Support other engineers through code reviews, design feedback, and pairing, particularly with junior and mid-level team members. Participate in on-call rotations for the services you help build, respond to incidents, and contribute to post-incident reviews. Contribute to Tempo as an open-source project by reviewing external contributions and engaging with the community. Required Qualifications Demonstrated experience delivering complex, multi-month technical projects, from design and implementation through production operations. Significant hands-on experience building and operating distributed data systems in production, such as ingestion pipelines, storage engines, or query execution systems. Strong software engineering skills, with the ability to write maintainable, reliable, and performant code. Solid experience with Go, or experience in systems languages such as Rust, C, or C++ that provides a foundation for working with Go. Experience owning production services, participating in on-call rotations, reducing operational toil, and working with service-level objectives. A pragmatic approach to solving technical problems, with an ability to break complex work into manageable steps, deliver initial solutions, and improve them through feedback. Clear written and verbal communication skills, including experience contributing to design documents, code reviews, and collaborative engineering work in a remote, asynchronous setting. Preferred Qualifications / Requirements Experience with distributed tracing, OpenTelemetry, or large-scale observability systems. Experience designing query languages, SQL- or TraceQL-like engines, or APIs intended for programmatic use by services and AI agents. Familiarity with columnar storage formats such as Parquet or purpose-built on-disk formats for analytical workloads. Experience operating multi-tenant, multi-cell SaaS infrastructure at scale on Kubernetes. Experience developing systems for AI and large language model consumers, including structured APIs, metadata discovery, deterministic outputs, and evaluation frameworks. Open-source contributions or project maintainership, with an interest in engaging with developer communities. Experience using Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, or Tempo in an on-call role or through a home lab. Experience working with fully remote, globally distributed teams. Salary & Benefits The US on-target earnings (OTE) and base compensation range for this role is USD $154,445–$185,334. Actual compensation may vary based on the candidate's level, experience, and skill set. Compensation ranges are country-specific, and candidates applying from other locations will be informed of the applicable market pay range and benefits by their recruiter. All roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving team members ownership in Grafana Labs' success. The company also provides a global annual leave policy of 30 days per year, including three days reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days, subject to applicable local legislation. Other benefits and workplace practices include remote work, in-person onboarding, transparent communication, career development opportunities, and access to company-funded AI coding assistant usage within security guidelines. Equal Opportunity / EEO Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. The company welcomes applications regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic protected by local law. Grafana Labs believes equality and diversity are essential to building a strong organization. Grafana Labs may use AI tools during recruitment to help match information provided in CVs with job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review applications manually to assess alignment with current openings.
